name: Dwarven Tinder
summary: In the Wetlands, Alliance saboteurs carry Dwarven Tinder to burn Dragonmaw siege engines before they reach Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Dragonmaw
sections.body:
Alliance scouts found Chieftain Nek'rosh's heavy catapults in the Dragonmaw encampment, and Menethil Harbor faced a crisis. Fighting in Dun Algaz had cut the harbor off from southern reinforcements. Its defenders could not withstand a long siege, so they chose to sabotage the catapults before they could be used.

Volunteers carried Dwarven Tinder into orcish territory and lit it with a struck spark. Its flames burned through the reinforced wooden engines in minutes.

faq.q: What is Dwarven Tinder used for?
faq.answer: Alliance saboteurs use Dwarven Tinder to burn Dragonmaw catapults in the Wetlands before they can attack Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why burn the catapults instead of capturing them?
aliases: why not take the siege engines
faq.answer: The defenders cannot capture heavy siege engines deep in Dragonmaw territory. Outnumbered and cut off from Ironforge reinforcements by the blockade at Dun Algaz, they see destroying the catapults as their only viable defense.

aliases: where does dwarven tinder come from
faq.answer: The dwarven garrison at Menethil Harbor supplies the tinder, prepared to catch fire quickly and reliably during sabotage runs.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know dependable firestarters matter in the Wetlands, where rain and bogs keep the land perpetually soggy.
As an Alliance member, you know burning enemy war engines before they reach Menethil Harbor helps keep your primary marsh port standing while the Dun Algaz passes are contested.
